realEstate.type: Fondation Louis Vuitton museum building (Frank Gehry; opened 20 Oct 2014; cost ~EUR 780m by 2017); on a concession, it passes to the City of Paris after 55 years

trophies.what: Paris FC - promoted to Ligue 1 on 2 May 2025; moved to Stade Jean-Bouin for 2025-26; finished 11th in 2025-26
Fondation Louis Vuitton (Paris contemporary art museum commissioned by Arnault)
Superyacht Symphony (Feadship, 101.5 m, delivered 2015, ~$150m) - owned asset

Wine estates in the group, incl. Château Cheval Blanc (with Frère family) and Château d'Yquem (LVMH)

policy.what: Milan court placed Loro Piana under judicial administration (July 2025) over labour exploitation at subcontractors; court lifted the measure early in April 2026
Milan court placed Manufactures Dior SRL under one-year judicial administration (June 2024) over exploitative conditions at four suppliers
Italian competition authority (AGCM) probe into Dior (opened July 2024) over possibly misleading consumers about labour/supply-chain practices
Dior customer-data breach discovered 7 May 2025 (mainly China customers: names, contacts, purchase history)
Anti-corruption group's complaint alleging ~EUR 603m in state tax benefits for Fondation Louis Vuitton was dismissed in Sept 2019 (older)
